# SHAUGHV CDN Docs

> How to use fonts, brand assets, motion drop-ins, and packages from cdn.shaughv.com.

# SHAUGHV CDN
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/

Use the CDN to load fonts, brand assets, motion components, and downloads across authorized SHAUGHV projects. Link the original asset instead of copying it into each app.

These searchable docs are published at both **cdn.shaughv.com** and **cdn.emmetts.dev**. Use **cdn.shaughv.com** for current asset URLs; the older domain preserves its existing files. Public access does not grant redistribution rights.

<a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/fonts.html">Open the font guide</a>

**[Quickstart](/quickstart)**

Paste one URL and start using fonts, marks, or packages.

**[Fonts](/fonts)**

Makira + Paper Mono are standard. Gail Rock stays compatible; two other families are opt-in.

**[Brand](/brand)**

Wordmarks, favicons, and transparent figurines with live previews.

**[Motion](/motion)**

Browser-ready animated mark and loader drop-ins.

## What lives here

| Path | What you get |
| --- | --- |
| `/fonts/` | Family stylesheets plus web and desktop font files |
| `/brand/` | Official wordmarks, favicons, and figurines |
| `/js/` | Animated brand mark and loader custom elements |
| `/site/` | The visual CDN website and font guide |
| `/` | This documentation; `/docs` redirects here |

:::tip
If you do not know the filename, fetch [`/tree.json`](https://cdn.shaughv.com/tree.json) instead of guessing. It lists every hosted file with a paste-ready URL.
:::

## How delivery works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Your site] -->|HTTPS GET| B[cdn.shaughv.com]
  B --> C[Vercel edge cache]
  C -->|miss| D[Static deployment]
  D --> C
  C --> A
```

There is no application server in front of the files. Each object keeps the `Content-Type` and `Cache-Control` set by the static deployment. Binaries are immutable for a year. CSS and JavaScript use a one-day cache with a seven-day stale-while-revalidate window.

## Visual identity

The website and these docs share the same cream, olive, and sage system.

- **Cream 200**: `#F5F5F0`

- **Sage**: `#5B8A5B`

- **Olive**: `#5C5446`

- **Bamboo**: `#C4A876`

- **Action**: `#4A7A4A`

Use the SVG from /brand/shaughv/logos/.

![SHAUGHV wordmark](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/wordmark.svg)

Official SHAUGHV wordmark

## Standard type pair

Makira and Paper Mono can both carry titles, interfaces, body copy, and buttons. Paper Mono is also the preferred monospace for code and data.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/fonts.css" />
```

# Brand assets
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand

Identity files live under `/brand/shaughv/`. Link them. Do not redraw the mark or recrop a figurine unless you are producing a new named asset.

## Wordmark

The static fallback when the animated mark is not loaded.

![Official SHAUGHV wordmark](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/wordmark.svg)

SHAUGHV-Official.svg

```html
<img
  src="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/logos/SHAUGHV-Official.svg"
  alt="SHAUGHV"
/>
```

On dark surfaces, invert the SVG with CSS rather than shipping a second file:

```css
.wordmark-on-olive {
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
}
```

## Favicons

The pair follows the visitor's color scheme: dark mark on light browser chrome, light mark on dark chrome.

<div class="cdn-swatch-row">
  <div class="cdn-swatch" style="background:#fafaf8;color:#5c5446;">
    ![Dark SHAUGHV favicon](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/favicon-dark.svg)
    <strong>Dark favicon</strong>
    <small>Light scheme</small>
  </div>
  <div class="cdn-swatch" style="background:#5c5446;color:#f5f5f0;">
    ![Light SHAUGHV favicon](/blume-assets/content/docs/images/favicon-light.svg)
    <strong>Light favicon</strong>
    <small>Dark scheme</small>
  </div>
</div>

```html
<link rel="icon" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/favicons/SHAUGHV-Favicon-Dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)">
<link rel="icon" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/favicons/SHAUGHV-Favicon-Light.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)">
```

Alternate marks also exist:

- `SHAUGHV-Favicon-Dark-Alt.svg`
- `SHAUGHV-Favicon-Light-Alt.svg`

# Downloads
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/downloads

Two public packages travel with the CDN. They are downloads, not site pages.

## Prompt research archive

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Address | `https://cdn.shaughv.com/prompts` |
| Redirect | HTTP 302 to the original S3 archive; its availability is separate from Vercel |
| Behavior | Redirects to the large original research ZIP |

```html
<a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/prompts">Download prompt research archive</a>
```

## Prompt skill bundle

One HTTP response cannot reliably trigger two file downloads. `prompts-skill.zip` nests the two original skill archives so a single click stays intact.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Address | `https://cdn.shaughv.com/prompts-skill` |
| Type | `application/zip` attachment |
| Contains | `agentic-prompt-engineering.zip` and `loop-escape.zip` |

```html
<a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/prompts-skill" download>Download prompt skill packages</a>
```

:::note
The outer zip stores the inner archives without recompressing them. Replace a nested skill by rebuilding the outer archive and updating the expected hashes in the test suite.
:::

## Website entry

The CDN overview lists both packages under **The packages.** with copy that matches these addresses.

<a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/index.html#downloads">Open the Downloads section</a>

# Fonts
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts

The SHAUGHV type system is two versatile families, not a headline font plus a body font. Use either one for titles, display, interfaces, body copy, or buttons. Paper Mono also gives code and data a precise grid.

**[Makira](/fonts/makira)**

Standard sans. Weights 400–900, static and variable.

**[Paper Mono](/fonts/paper-mono)**

Standard mono. Weights 100–800, static and variable.

**[IBM Plex Mono](/fonts/opt-in)**

Optional quieter mono with italics.

**[Unbounded](/fonts/opt-in)**

Optional geometric display family.

## Load the standard pair

```html HTML
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/fonts.css" />
```

```css CSS
@import url("https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/fonts.css");
```

That one file imports Makira and Paper Mono, plus Gail Rock for compatibility with existing sites. The live manifest records the preferred pair in `fonts.all.defaults`. It does **not** import IBM Plex Mono or Unbounded.

## Family names

| Family | Status | CSS family names | Weights |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Makira | Standard | `"Makira"`, `"Makira VF"` | 400–900 |
| Paper Mono | Standard | `"Paper Mono"`, `"Paper Mono Variable"` | 100–800 |
| Gail Rock | Compatibility | `"Gail Rock"`, `"Gail Rock VF"` | 100–700 |
| IBM Plex Mono | Opt-in | `"IBM Plex Mono"` | 100–700, italic |
| Unbounded | Opt-in | `"Unbounded"`, `"Unbounded Blond"`, `"Unbounded Variable"` | 300–900 + variable 100–900 |

## Side by side

The same sentence in both standard voices:

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Makira</span>
  <p class="cdn-makira cdn-display">Ready for the whole interface.</p>
  <p class="cdn-makira cdn-body">Clear at reading sizes, forceful at display sizes, and comfortable on controls.</p>
</div>

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Paper Mono</span>
  <p class="cdn-paper cdn-display">Ready for the whole interface.</p>
  <p class="cdn-paper cdn-body">Expressive at display sizes, readable in body copy, and precise for code and data.</p>
</div>

:::warning
Do not add another family to the standard bundle without an explicit brand decision. Opt-in stylesheets exist so a project can ask for a third voice on purpose.
:::

## Recommended CSS variables

```css
:root {
  --font-makira: "Makira", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-paper: "Paper Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --font-mono-alt: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  --font-brutal: "Unbounded", system-ui, sans-serif;
}
```

The live font guide at <a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/fonts.html">visual font guide</a> shows both families across display, body, interface, and control roles, plus Gail Rock's compatibility specimens.

---

# Gail Rock
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/gail-rock

Paper Mono is the preferred monospace for new installations. Gail Rock remains in the combined stylesheet for existing designs.

Gail Rock is a true monospace: every encoded glyph shares the same 650-unit advance. It is still a full interface family. Titles, body, buttons, and data can all wear it. The grid is a capability, not a restriction to code blocks.

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Display / 700</span>
  <p class="cdn-gail cdn-display">Make the headline count.</p>
</div>

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Code preset / unmarked O + slashed zero</span>
  <p class="cdn-gail cdn-body" style="font-feature-settings:'zero' 1;">const token = 0x00A0;<br />font-family: "Gail Rock";</p>
</div>

## Load it

Included in `fonts/fonts.css`. Solo import:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/gail-rock/gail-rock.css" />
```

## CSS families

| Name | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `"Gail Rock"` | Static 100–700 |
| `"Gail Rock VF"` | Variable 100–700 |

Static files on the CDN: Thin, Extralight, Light, Regular, Medium, Semibold, Bold.

## OpenType voices

The grid never changes. Features switch the drawing of specific glyphs.

| Feature | Effect | Use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| default | Unmarked O/o | Body and the recommended code look |
| `ss01` | Center-marked O/o, single-storey a/g, alternate Q/4 | Signature display |
| `ss02` | Slashed O/o and accented forms | A sharper display voice |
| `zero` | Slashed numeral 0 | Code and data |
| `dlig` | FI, LI, ft, tr ligatures | Short display copy |

:::warning
Choose `ss01` or `ss02` for expressive O forms, not both. `zero` and `dlig` can layer independently.
:::

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Default O o · a g 4 Q</span>
  <p class="cdn-gail cdn-display">O o a g 4 Q</p>
</div>

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">ss01 signature</span>
  <p class="cdn-gail cdn-display" style="font-feature-settings:'ss01' 1;">O o a g 4 Q</p>
</div>

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">ss02 slash</span>
  <p class="cdn-gail cdn-display" style="font-feature-settings:'ss02' 1;">O o Ó ó</p>
</div>

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">zero · capital O beside slashed 0</span>
  <p class="cdn-gail cdn-display" style="font-feature-settings:'zero' 1;">O 0 00A0</p>
</div>

## Best for code

Keep the default, unmarked O/o and enable `zero` so numeral 0 cannot be confused with capital O. The feature name is literal: `zero` changes 0, while `ss01` is the option that puts a center mark in O/o.

```css
.gail-code {
  font-family: "Gail Rock", ui-monospace, monospace;
  font-feature-settings: "zero" 1;
}
.gail-signature { font-feature-settings: "ss01" 1; }
.gail-slashed-o { font-feature-settings: "ss02" 1; }
.gail-ligatures { font-feature-settings: "dlig" 1; }
```

The font guide at <a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/fonts.html">visual font guide</a> includes a live weight-axis specimen and copyable CSS for every switch.

# Makira
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/makira

Makira is the versatile sans in the standard pair. It is not reserved for headlines. Use it anywhere the surface should feel owned without a fixed-pitch grid.

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Display / 700</span>
  <p class="cdn-makira cdn-display">One address. Every asset.</p>
</div>

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Body / 400</span>
  <p class="cdn-makira cdn-body">Fonts, marks, favicons, figurines, and browser-ready motion for SHAUGHV projects. Link the exact thing you need. Use it anywhere.</p>
</div>

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">UI label / 700</span>
  <p class="cdn-makira" style="margin:0;font-size:0.72rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;">Asset delivery / CDN</p>
</div>

## Load it

The standard bundle already includes Makira. A project that only wants this family can still link the dedicated file:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/makira/makira.css" />
```

## CSS families

| Name | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `"Makira"` | Static cuts, 400–900 |
| `"Makira VF"` | Variable 400–900 |

```css
.hero-title {
  font-family: "Makira", system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
```

## Files on the CDN

- fonts/makira/
  - makira.css
  - woff2/ — browser-first webfonts
  - woff/
  - ttf/
  - otf/
  - variable/ — `"Makira VF"`

Static filenames follow `Makira-Regular.woff2`, `Makira-Medium.woff2`, `Makira-SemiBold.woff2`, `Makira-Bold.woff2`, `Makira-ExtraBold.woff2`, and `Makira-Black.woff2`.

:::tip
If a cut ever needs a hint regen or a glyph addition, ship a new filename. Binary objects are cached as immutable. Never overwrite `Makira-Bold.woff2` in place.
:::

## License

Makira is commercially licensed for authorized SHAUGHV use. Public font URLs do not grant permission to redistribute its binaries. Use the hosted CSS rather than committing it to public repositories.

# Opt-in families
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/opt-in

The standard stylesheet stays focused on Makira and Paper Mono. These two families are fully hosted, but each has its own CSS file.

## IBM Plex Mono

A quieter optional mono for technical labels, code, and dense metadata. Normal and italic, 100–700.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/ibm-plex-mono/ibm-plex-mono.css" />
```

```css
.meta {
  font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
  font-weight: 500;
}
```

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">IBM Plex Mono / 700</span>
  <p class="cdn-plex cdn-display">IBM Plex Mono</p>
  <p class="cdn-plex cdn-body">status: ready · GET /tree.json</p>
</div>

:::note
Paper Mono remains the standard code face. Reach for IBM Plex Mono when a surface wants a less expressive mono, especially if italic is required.
:::

## Unbounded

Wide geometric display cuts, plus a variable family across 100–900. Also includes the Blond cut.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/unbounded/unbounded.css" />
```

```css
.display {
  font-family: "Unbounded", "Makira", sans-serif;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
```

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Unbounded / 700</span>
  <p class="cdn-unbounded cdn-display">Unbounded</p>
</div>

:::warning
Unbounded's embedded copyright identifies Parity Technologies. Do not describe it as SIL Open Font License unless a later license file says so.
:::

## When to opt in

| Need | Choice |
| --- | --- |
| Default SHAUGHV interface | Makira and/or Paper Mono |
| Code with a slashed zero on a brand grid | Paper Mono + `zero` |
| Italic mono, quieter texture | IBM Plex Mono |
| Extra-wide geometric display | Unbounded |

---

# Paper Mono
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono

Paper Mono is the default monospace for new SHAUGHV projects. Pair it with Makira for labels, code, data, interfaces, and display text.

<div class="cdn-specimen">
  <span class="cdn-specimen-label">Paper Mono / 700</span>
  <p class="cdn-paper cdn-display">Make the headline count.</p>
  <p class="cdn-paper cdn-body">const token = 0x00A0;</p>
</div>

## Install

The combined stylesheet includes the preferred Makira + Paper Mono pair. Gail Rock remains included for compatibility with existing designs; fonts are downloaded only when used.

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/fonts.css" />
```

For Paper Mono alone:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono/paper-mono.css" />
```

```css
code, pre, .metadata {
  font-family: "Paper Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
}
.continuous-weight {
  font-family: "Paper Mono Variable", ui-monospace, monospace;
  font-weight: 450;
}
```

## Files and weights

| Build | Formats | Weights | CSS family |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Static | WOFF2, TTF, OTF | 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800 | `"Paper Mono"` |
| Variable | WOFF2, TTF | Continuous 100–800 | `"Paper Mono Variable"` |

All 26 supplied font files are hosted without changing their bytes. The variable filenames are normalized to `PaperMono-Variable`. Normal style is supplied; there is no separate italic.

Printable ASCII has fixed advances. Combining marks and some extended glyphs have different advances, so check your actual content when exact columns matter.

## License and discovery

Paper Mono uses the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The [OFL](https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono/OFL.txt), [copyright notice](https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono/LICENSE.txt), and [verified metadata](https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/paper-mono/font-info.json) accompany the font files.

Use `fonts["paper-mono"]` in the [live catalog](https://cdn.shaughv.com/tree.json) for the current stylesheet and `fonts.all.defaults` for the recommended pair. The [visual font guide](https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/fonts.html) includes an interactive variable-weight specimen.

## OpenType features

The supplied variable font includes `zero`, `calt`, `frac`, `ss01`–`ss04`,
`cv01`, and other tags recorded in its metadata. Enable the slashed-zero option
with `font-feature-settings: "zero" 1`. Stylistic-set meanings are specific to
Paper Mono; do not reuse Gail Rock's alternate-glyph descriptions for it.

## Choosing a format

Use the family stylesheet for browsers; it prefers WOFF2. Use TTF or OTF for
compatible desktop software, retaining the license notices. Choose the
variable family when a design needs intermediate weights such as 450. To avoid
synthetic italics, set `font-synthesis: none` where the absence of an italic
face matters, or explicitly choose an italic-capable family.

---

# Hosting and updates
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/hosting

## Two domains, one documentation source

| Host | Role | Hosting |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cdn.shaughv.com` | Current asset catalog and documentation | Vercel static deployment |
| `cdn.emmetts.dev` | Documentation mirror and preserved legacy assets | GitHub Pages |

Both homepages publish the same Blume build. Current font, brand, motion, and
download examples use `cdn.shaughv.com`. The older domain keeps its existing
asset paths, but it is not a second copy of the current catalog.

The primary CDN uses Vercel DNS and managed HTTPS. The documentation mirror
keeps its existing DNS and GitHub Pages custom domain. No runtime function,
database, or Blob store is required. The original R2 bucket is a historical
snapshot, not the current origin or a synchronized backup.

## Free hosting boundaries

The primary site uses Vercel Hobby. Its transfer and request allowances are
shared with other projects on the account; they are not unlimited. Check
[Vercel's current plan documentation](https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby)
before changing the audience or increasing traffic. GitHub Pages applies its
own service limits to the mirror. No paid subscription was added for this setup.

## Documentation follows repository changes

The private `RealEmmettS/shaughv-cdn` repository is the canonical source for
assets, the catalog, and the Markdown/MDX pages. Blume is pinned in the lockfile.
Its build produces navigation, local search, page HTML, Markdown exports,
agent discovery, social images, and the sitemap together.

Every change must update affected documentation before it is pushed. The
repository's agent instructions require checking URLs, font defaults,
examples, and workflows, followed by the docs build and strict link validation.
GitHub CI checks the same build. There is no scheduled AI maintenance job.

```bash
npm ci
npm run docs:check
bash scripts/deploy.sh --dry-run
npx blume validate --strict
bash scripts/test.sh
```

On Windows, run the shell commands through Git Bash. The public preview uses
`python3 scripts/serve-site.py` after the build and binds to localhost.

## Publishing both hosts

Deploy the complete public package to a Vercel preview and verify it before
publishing production. Then use the repository's Pages publisher to copy the
same compiled documentation into the existing `RealEmmettS/Shaughnessy-CDN`
checkout. Push its `main` branch to trigger GitHub Pages.

The publisher preserves legacy assets and `CNAME`, tracks the generated files
it owns, and removes obsolete generated files on subsequent updates. Fonts
are loaded from their canonical CDN URLs rather than copied into the public
mirror. Private source and maintenance files are excluded from both outputs.

## Verification and recovery

Check rendered pages, search, navigation, mobile layout, and actual font loading.
The primary CDN's live verifier also checks exact file bytes, response types,
cache policy, CORS, downloads, byte ranges, missing files, and cache hits.
HTTP success alone does not prove that a font rendered or a search result works.

For a broken Vercel release, roll back to a previously verified deployment.
For a broken Pages update, revert the publishing commit and wait for the Pages
build to finish. Preserve immutable asset URLs: changed binary files need new
filenames because a deployment cannot clear a visitor's browser cache.

---

# Motion
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/motion

Two browser-ready custom elements cover the animated wordmark loop and the official loader. Both inherit `currentColor` and skip motion when the visitor asks for less of it.

## Animated brand mark

`js/animated-brand-mark.js` defines `<shaughv-mark>`. The loop is:

1. Wordmark holds
2. Undraws
3. Portrait (mustache + glasses) draws in
4. Undraws
5. Wordmark returns

```html
<shaughv-mark
  style="display:block;width:96px;height:96px;color:currentColor"
  aria-label="SHAUGHV"
></shaughv-mark>
<script src="https://cdn.shaughv.com/js/animated-brand-mark.js"></script>
```

Hold a static frame with `data-static` (the footer of the CDN website does this):

```html
<shaughv-mark data-static aria-label="SHAUGHV"></shaughv-mark>
```

A React source port also ships at `js/react/AnimatedBrandMark.jsx` for projects that already own the component tree. The vanilla custom element is the default for HTML pages.

:::tip
Color comes from CSS. Set `color` on the host. Do not recolor individual SVG paths.
:::

## Loader

`js/shaughv-loader.js` defines `<shaughv-loader>`. The portrait fills, drains, and morphs through a goo filter into a blob, then returns. Timing, paths, and geometry are part of the recipe.

```html
<shaughv-loader style="color:var(--accent);height:120px"></shaughv-loader>
<script src="https://cdn.shaughv.com/js/shaughv-loader.js"></script>
```

The loader will fetch Anime.js from jsDelivr if the page has not already loaded it. The CDN website loads Anime.js itself so the mark choreography and the loader share one copy.

## Reduced motion

Both drop-ins honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. The mark stays on the static wordmark. The loader does not run the morph loop. Keep that behavior if you wrap either element.

## Live preview

The homepage Assets section mounts both elements against cream stages so you can confirm color inheritance before copying the snippet.

<a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/index.html#assets">Open the Assets section</a>

---

# Quickstart
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/quickstart

Every consumer path is a normal HTTPS URL. You do not copy licensed font files or brand originals into each project.

1. **Pick the origin**

    Use `https://cdn.shaughv.com/` for current assets. Both CDN homepages show this documentation; older `cdn.emmetts.dev` asset links remain available.

2. **Link what the page needs**

    Fonts take a stylesheet. Marks and loaders take a custom-element tag plus a script. Images take an `src`.

3. **Leave binaries on the CDN**

    Prefer CDN links for shared project assets. Makira and brand assets have restricted redistribution; Paper Mono is available under its included OFL license.

## Fastest useful paste

**Fonts**

The standard pair in one line:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/fonts.css" />
```

Then in CSS:

```css
:root {
  --font-makira: "Makira", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-paper: "Paper Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
}
body { font-family: var(--font-makira); }
code, pre {
  font-family: var(--font-paper);
  font-feature-settings: "zero" 1;
}
```

**Favicon pair**

Light and dark icons that follow the visitor's color scheme:

```html
<link rel="icon" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/favicons/SHAUGHV-Favicon-Dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)">
<link rel="icon" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/favicons/SHAUGHV-Favicon-Light.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)">
```

**Animated mark**

```html
<shaughv-mark style="display:block;width:96px;height:96px;color:currentColor" aria-label="SHAUGHV"></shaughv-mark>
<script src="https://cdn.shaughv.com/js/animated-brand-mark.js"></script>
```

## Local preview of this website

This repository can show the public pages without uploading anything:

```bash
npm ci
npm run docs:check
bash scripts/deploy.sh --dry-run
python3 scripts/serve-site.py
```

Then open:

- `/` — documentation homepage
- `/fonts` — font documentation
- `/site/index.html` — original visual overview
- `/site/fonts.html` — interactive font guide

:::note
The preview serves only the built public files and binds to localhost by default. On Windows, run shell scripts with Git Bash.
:::

## Discover files instead of memorizing them

```bash
curl -s https://cdn.shaughv.com/tree.json | python3 -m json.tool | head
```

Agents should read `/tree.json` and use each leaf's `url`, `embed`, or a family's `css_url`. Do not hardcode a private inventory of paths.

# Recipes
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/recipes

These are complete, boring recipes. Swap colors and sizes; keep the URLs.

## A marketing page

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <title>SHAUGHV project</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/fonts/fonts.css" />
    <link rel="icon" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/favicons/SHAUGHV-Favicon-Dark.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)">
    <link rel="icon" href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/favicons/SHAUGHV-Favicon-Light.svg" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)">
    <style>
      :root {
        --font-makira: "Makira", system-ui, sans-serif;
        --font-paper: "Paper Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
        --bg: #f5f5f0;
        --fg: #5c5446;
        --accent: #5b8a5b;
      }
      body {
        margin: 0;
        background: var(--bg);
        color: var(--fg);
        font-family: var(--font-makira);
      }
      h1 {
        font-family: var(--font-paper);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: -0.04em;
        line-height: 0.92;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <shaughv-mark style="display:block;width:72px;height:72px;color:var(--accent)" aria-label="SHAUGHV"></shaughv-mark>
    <h1>One address.<br>Every asset.</h1>
    <script src="https://cdn.shaughv.com/js/animated-brand-mark.js"></script>
  </body>
</html>
```

## A docs or app shell

Makira for chrome and body, Paper Mono for code with the recommended zero.

```css
:root {
  --font-ui: "Makira", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-code: "Paper Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;
}
html { font-family: var(--font-ui); }
code, kbd, pre, samp {
  font-family: var(--font-code);
  font-feature-settings: "zero" 1;
}
```

## A loading state

Keep the loader recipe intact. Change only color and box size.

```html
<div style="display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:40vh;background:#f5f5f0;color:#5b8a5b;">
  <shaughv-loader style="height:120px"></shaughv-loader>
</div>
<script src="https://cdn.shaughv.com/js/shaughv-loader.js"></script>
```

## An article with a figurine

```html
<img
  src="https://cdn.shaughv.com/brand/shaughv/figurines/transparent/figurine-header.webp"
  alt="SHAUGHV figurine"
  style="width:min(100%,22rem)"
/>
```

## Agent consumption

Do not scrape these docs for a file list. Fetch the catalog:

```js
const tree = await fetch("https://cdn.shaughv.com/tree.json").then((r) => r.json());
if (!tree.fonts?.all?.defaults) throw new Error("Missing font defaults");
const monoKey = tree.fonts.all.defaults.monospace;
const css = tree.fonts[monoKey].css_url;
```

The `/agents` skill teaches the same workflow without enumerating paths.

# Reference
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/reference

Short facts the website implies and `/tree.json` makes explicit.

## Origin

`https://cdn.shaughv.com`

Always HTTPS. Do not use the `public.r2.dev` development hostname in production code.

## Namespaces

| Prefix | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `/brand/` | Wordmarks, favicons, figurines |
| `/fonts/` | Family CSS plus webfonts and desktop files |
| `/js/` | Custom elements and the React mark port |
| `/site/` | Visual website HTML, CSS, and JS |
| `/` | Blume documentation; `/docs` redirects here |
| `/tree.json` | Generated catalog |
| `/agents` | Markdown skill download |
| `/prompts` | Research archive redirect |
| `/prompts-skill` | Nested skill ZIP |

## Cache

| Kind | Policy |
| --- | --- |
| Catalog fonts, images, media | `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` |
| CSS, JS, HTML, JSON, generated documentation | `public, max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800` |

Replace a mutable CSS/JS file in place. Ship a new filename for any binary that changed.

## CORS

On `cdn.shaughv.com`, `GET`, `HEAD`, and `OPTIONS` use `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`. Preflight returns 204. Byte ranges return 206, and CORS exposes content length, content range, ETag, and cache metadata. Missing assets return 404 rather than an HTML success response.

These custom headers describe the primary Vercel CDN. The documentation mirror at `cdn.emmetts.dev` uses GitHub Pages caching and response headers.

## Discovery

| URL | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `/tree` and `/tree.json` | Machine-readable inventory |
| `/agents` | Skill that teaches agents to read the inventory |
| `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` | Compact index and complete Markdown documentation |
| `/index.md`, `/fonts/paper-mono.md` | Markdown page exports |
| `/.well-known/api-catalog` | API discovery linkset |
| `/.well-known/ai-catalog.json` | Agent discovery catalog |
| `/openapi.json` | Generated documentation API description |
| `/agent-readability.json` | Generated machine-readability information |

## Human pages

| Address | File |
| --- | --- |
| `/` | Blume documentation homepage |
| `/fonts` | Font documentation overview |
| `/fonts/paper-mono` | Paper Mono installation and format reference |
| `/site/index.html` | Original visual overview on the primary CDN |
| `/site/fonts.html` | Interactive visual font guide on the primary CDN |
| `/docs` | Permanent redirect to `/` on the primary CDN |

Deeper paths such as `/fonts/fonts.css` are real objects and must not be rewritten.

---

# Website layout
Source: https://cdn.shaughv.com/website

Blume 2.2.2 powers the documentation homepage on both CDN domains, with local search, navigation, Markdown exports, and agent discovery. The original visual guides remain available separately as two HTML pages plus shared CSS and JS:

- site/
  - index.html — CDN overview
  - fonts.html — complete typography guide
  - site.css — layout, type, breakpoints
  - site.js — nav, copy buttons, motion, reveals

Both pages share the header, cream field, sage accents, and Paper Mono display titles. Catalog labels on the homepage use Makira so four columns stay one family instead of four competing mono letterforms.

## Header

Links: Fonts, Assets, Downloads, **Docs**, and the Start coding action. Below 960px the bar collapses to a 44px hamburger with keyboard dismiss, outside click, and Escape.

<a href="https://cdn.shaughv.com/site/index.html">Open the visual overview</a> to confirm the Docs item lands on these pages.

## Homepage catalog

The "Four ways in." section is a four-column grid on wide screens and two columns below 1280px. Each card is a container: the title scales from the card width (`cqi`) so TYPE, IDENTITY, MOTION, and PACKAGES stay inside the rules at every width.

| Width | Catalog |
| --- | --- |
| ≥ 1280px | Four columns |
| 481px–1279px | Two columns |
| ≤ 480px | One column |

Cell borders are right + bottom on every card, so changing the column count never leaves a missing or doubled rule.

## Other reflow points

| Width | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| 1080px | Hero stacks, section headings stack, font-brief stacks |
| 960px | Header becomes a menu |
| 760px | Asset grids, specimens, downloads, and footer stack |
| 480px | Hero actions stretch, receipt chrome stacks, catalog is one column |

Display titles use `overflow-wrap` and `text-wrap: balance` so long Paper Mono words wrap inside the measure instead of painting through the next column.

## Preview locally

```bash
python3 scripts/serve-site.py
```

Check the visual overview and font guide at 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, and 390. The catalog, hero receipt, and font specimens are the places overflow used to show up first.

:::note
Screenshots from those widths belong next to this page when a pass is captured during review. The live pages remain the source of truth.
:::

## Shared asset cache markers

`site/index.html` and `site/fonts.html` load `site.css` and `site.js` with the first 12 characters of each file's SHA-256 as `?v=`. Tests fail if a marker drifts after an edit.
